title: Short Line is a third railroad but Alpha is rent-exposed
description: Short Line is a third railroad but Alpha is rent-exposed. The third railroad is useful, but buying leaves Alpha unable to survive developed red. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying Short Line gives me a second railroad, raising rent to $50 on both. With $245 cash, after purchase I'll have $45, enough for basic expenses. Declining risks an auction where others could acquire it cheaply, strengthening their position. I accept the purchase.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses start_auction for this exact purchase/auction context.
Did not satisfy: Preserves at least $220 instead of buying into rent danger.
Private thought names why passing to auction is better here.
